::api-operation{method="POST" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/customer_segments"}
#docs
An attribute the stored data cannot express is refused with a 400 that NAMES it and says why — never answered slowly by rebuilding the book. A filter on `mrr` compares in the business's default currency: each live subscription's MRR is converted at the business's stored rate before comparing, and the value is minor units of that currency. Pin `currency is X` to compare natively in X instead. A held currency with no usable rate is refused, naming it.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Body

The request body is **required**.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | **yes** | The segment's name. |
| `description` | `string` | no | The segment's description. |
| `filters` | `array of object` | **yes** | At least one. An empty set is 'all customers' wearing a name, which the screen already has an entry for. |
| `filters.field` | `string` | **yes** | A customer attribute, e.g. `country`, `mrr`. |
| `filters.op` | `string` | **yes** | is, in, gt, gte, lt, between, in_last, … |
| `filters.value` | `string` | **yes** | Comma-separated for `in` and `between`. |
| `starter_key` | `string` | no | Set when duplicating a starter, so the copy records where it came from. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `customer_segment`. One of `customer_segment`. |
| `id` | `string` | seg_…, or seg_starter_… for a starter |
| `name` | `string` | The segment's name. |
| `description` | `string` | The segment's description. |
| `filters` | `array of object` | The predicate, in the customer list's own filter grammar. |
| `is_starter` | `boolean` | A definition that ships with the product. Present on every business, read-only, and not stored as a row. |
| `starter_key` | `string` | Which starter this was copied from, if any. |
| `created_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the customer segment was created (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `updated_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the customer segment was last changed (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `answerable` | `boolean` | On the list only: whether this business can resolve the segment. False for an `mrr` threshold with no currency pinned on a book billing in several currencies. |
| `refusal` | `string` | On the list only: why it cannot be resolved here, or null when it can. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `201` | Created |
| `400` | Invalid or refused filter set |
| `409` | A segment with that name already exists |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X POST "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/customer_segments" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "name": "Maya Castillo",
    "description": "Everything a growing team needs.",
    "filters": [
      {
        "field": "country",
        "op": "gte",
        "value": "West"
      }
    ]
  }'
```
